We are not responsible for any problems resulting from creating a custom resolution on your PC.

It may be that your monitor does not support a necessary display configuration. If so, you may try to set up a virtual monitor. Finally, if your device or host PC does not support streaming at a specific resolution or refresh rate, you're out of luck unfortunately.

This types text, not clipboard sync. Enter or Tab can move to another field or execute commands in Excel/ERP. Continue?

Drag the handle to move; fold to hide; swipe sideways for more buttons. Ctrl/Shift/Alt: one tap arms the next key or completed click (①), two taps lock (🔒), a third releases. Release keys clears all bar keys. Arrows repeat while held. Alt+Tab retains Alt for two seconds. Paste uses the PC clipboard. Type tablet → PC reads tablet text only when tapped, up to 2000 BMP characters; emoji are rejected. Enter/Tab require confirmation. New touch, pen, mouse or keyboard input cancels unsent text; already typed text remains. The cancel button stops typing. Hangul/Hanja target the Windows input method. Keyboard opens the existing Android keyboard; realtime Korean composition and F1/F2 drag-lock/acceleration are not included. Turn Touch enhancements or Shortcut bar off in settings to restore original input behavior.

Two fingers together: scroll. Hold one and move the other: left drag. Hold one and double-tap the other: right click. Three moving fingers: middle drag; a short stationary three-finger tap opens the keyboard. Applies to direct touch and trackpad; turn off for original gestures. With these gestures enabled, a stationary single finger waits for a second contact or release, even after 650 ms. Long-hold right click (direct touch) and long-hold drag (trackpad) are replaced; use anchored drag/right-click gestures or the bar. Disable work gestures to restore those original holds.
